Leon the boss
Oct 2026 • Friends
I had a wonderful dining experience, with absolutely delicious food and outstanding service from start to finish. Every dish was delightful, and the overall quality of the food truly exceeded my expectations. The atmosphere was welcoming, and the staff made the entire experience even more enjoyable through their professionalism and attentiveness.

I would especially like to commend Leon, who was exceptionally kind, friendly, and attentive throughout our visit. His warm personality and genuine hospitality made us feel very welcome and added a personal touch to the experience. It is always a pleasure to encounter staff members who go above and beyond to ensure their customers have a memorable time.

Overall, I highly recommend this restaurant to anyone looking for excellent food, outstanding service, and a genuinely pleasant dining experience. I would absolutely love to return!

A special mention to Sita for her warm welcome!
Oct 2026 • Family
We had a very good time at the Vị Sài Gòn restaurant. The dishes are delicious, the service is fast, and Sita, the waitress, is very kind, smiling, and attentive. The restaurant is pleasant and clean.

The only negative point is that the prices are quite high, especially for drinks: a glass of table wine costs 150,000 đ.

But overall, we really enjoyed our meal and the quality of the service. A special mention to Sita for her warm welcome!
